text: **dsh-task-status**（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在对话输入区上方显示后台任务状态。它通过 conversation.input.dock 槽渲染任务状态条，并由 Node 端路由提供任务列表和输出。用户可查看运行任务数量、展开任务详情与实时输出尾部；组件只在对话页显示，并按会话筛选活跃任务。适合需要在聊天时跟踪后台任务进度的 Web 用户。无需额外密钥或外部服务。

**dsh-task-status** (DSH Web plugin): Shows active background tasks above the chat input via conversation.input.dock. Node routes provide task lists and output; users can expand tasks to view details and live output. It filters by session and only appears in chat; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 聊天时看到后台任务是否还在运行
有没有办法在输入框上方显示任务进度
我想展开一个后台任务并查看它的输出
让 DSH 按当前会话显示正在运行的任务
后台命令启动后，怎么跟踪它的实时输出
Show me which background tasks are still running while I chat.
I want to expand a task and follow its output live.
Can the chat view show active tasks for the current session?
**dsh-task-status** 的功能「后台任务状态条」：在对话输入区上方显示当前会话运行中或停止中的任务及状态；无活跃任务时隐藏。
**dsh-task-status** 的功能「展开任务详情」：点击任务行可展开详情和输出区域；多任务时可展开任务列表。
**dsh-task-status** 的功能「实时输出尾部」：展开任务后每秒读取输出路由并更新文本，输出区域限高并可滚动查看。
**dsh-task-status** 的功能「任务数据路由」：Node 端注册任务列表与输出读取路由，列表包含 owned 和 unowned 任务，输出响应提供累积文本。

This plugin served the same need through `conversation.input.dock`, so the repository is frozen.

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Introduction：

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Introduction：A background-task status bar above the chat input box: running-task count + click-to-expand per-task details + **live output tail** (auto-polling, 10-line scrolling area). Registered through the official `conversation.input.dock` slot (same family as queue/todo/goal). Ships as an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient channel), 0 patches.

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Status bar | Dock card above the chat input box: `⚙ N background tasks running` |
| Expandable details | Click a task row to expand: status / duration / details + output tail |
| Live tail | Polls the output route every 1s while expanded, re-rendering the whole block (the mirror patch guarantees zero contention with the official `task_output` tool and a consistent view) |
| Scrolling area | Output area capped at 10 lines (160px); overflow becomes a scrollbar (tail keeps the end, scrollable to review) |
| Chat page only | Automatically hidden on non-Chat views (trajectory / taskboard, etc.) |

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Features：**Routes** (Node half):

| Route | Description |
|---|---|
| `/plugins/dsh-task-status/tasks` | Task list (read-only, filtered by session; owned + unowned union) |
| `/plugins/dsh-task-status/output` | Task output tail (`full:true` accumulates the full text; unknown id → 404) |

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Features：**Output tail contention semantics** (official 0809 API constraint): `tasks.read` is a consumptive, incremental read (one shared cursor per task). This plugin applies a **mirror patch** to `ctx.tasks.read` — the official read becomes buffered mirror (increments already read by others, not re-consumed) + direct read of the latest (normal consumption); the plugin's own reads go straight to the underlying rawRead. The official tool and the plugin see the same increment sequence (no duplicates, no loss); only the proactively self-read part can no longer be replayed by the official side alone (official semantics is inherently incremental, so model perception is unaffected).

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Usage：Run a background task and the status bar appears (e.g. the model-side `bash` tool with `run_in_background: true`):

```
⚙ 1 background task running
  ● bash-1  for i in $(seq 1 20)…   started 21:30:15   running
```

Click a task row to expand → the output tail scrolls live (a scrollbar appears once it exceeds 10 lines). The status bar disappears automatically when the task finishes.

@vlln/dsh-task-status README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build      # tsdown: Node half (lib/index.mjs) + client bundle (lib/client.js)
```

- Node half: `src/index.mjs` (mirror patch + `/tasks` `/output` routes)
- client: `src/client/task-status.tsx` (dock-slot status bar)
